task_completion.description: The agent successfully launched the CoppeliaSim application and is logged into the 'ga' account.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim GUI is visible on the screen, and the file explorer or terminal shows the user is 'ga'.

task_completion.description: A robot workcell and a proximity sensor are present in the CoppeliaSim scene.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewport shows a robot model and a proximity sensor object (often represented by a cone or pyramid volume).

task_completion.description: The agent moves the sensor to at least five different candidate mounting positions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A sequence of screenshots showing the proximity sensor at different X, Y, or Z coordinates relative to the robot workcell.

task_completion.description: The agent performs coverage analysis or records detection data for the placements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent interacting with sensor properties, running a simulation, or using a script/console within CoppeliaSim to calculate detection fractions.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurement records to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or terminal 'ls' command showing 'sensor_coverage.csv' in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final comparison report and recommendation to the specified JSON path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or text editor showing 'sensor_analysis.json' in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/ with a recommended location.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim GUI rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the CoppeliaSim scene tree, object properties, or simulation controls.

integrity.description: The sensor data is derived from the simulation environment, not hardcoded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the CSV/JSON correspond to the visual positions of the sensor seen in the 3D viewport during the task.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy existing result files from another directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively typing data or using export functions within the software or a script they authored.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must evaluate at least 5 distinct mounting positions. The required output files are exactly /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/sensor_coverage.csv (containing at least 5 rows of data) and /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/sensor_analysis.json (containing the recommendation). The agent starts with an empty scene and must build the simulation environment.
